one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-29. No earnings inside it: CEG's Q3 releases came on Nov 8 2022, Nov 6 2023, Nov 4 2024 and Nov 7 2025, so Q3 2026 most likely prints in the first week of November. The supervisor confirmed that PJM backstop (RBP) bids run Sep 30 to Oct 21, with results on Dec 2, and that the 2029/30 BRA is in December. Neither result lands in the window. The Oct 27-28 FOMC arrives with the 10y already at 5.24% (FRED) after the Sep 17 hike. I no longer lean on the one-day 43% hike-odds snapshot, which the supervisor discounted as noisy, but a hike stays a modest negative for a long-duration name. Calpine-holder supply: about 13-14M of the roughly 38M remaining consideration shares are unlocked and can be sold. That is a slow drain rather than a dated event. The stock rose 1.6% on 9/29 and has bounced from $254.71 (9/18). I see no edge from momentum or reversal. I use a near-symmetric lognormal centred on about $265 with about 12.5% monthly sigma (47%/3.5 = 13.4%, trimmed because realized vol includes the offering shock) and a 20% weight on a 16%-sigma component for fat tails. That is essentially unchanged from round 1.

fair_value.method: Blend of three methods. 60%: forward P/E on the 2028E that the market will price in Sep 2027, $14.6 (rebuilt from management's base plus enhanced framework, not grown from consensus) x 19x = $277. 25%: 2027E $13.0 x 20x = $260. 15%: 2028 FCFbG of $16.6 per share at a 6.5% yield = $255. The blend is about $270.

The framework gives about $12.9 at 6/30 forwards ($7.65 base plus about $5.3 enhanced). But the initial 2026 guide of $11-12 came in below the $11.72 consensus and the stock fell 7%. So I expect the Feb 2027 guide midpoint near $12.9, below the $13.34 consensus, with delivery around $13.0-13.3.

bear.story: The Feb 2027 guide lands well below consensus (e.g. $12.3 midpoint vs $13.3), repeating the Mar 2026 pattern but larger. The IPP de-rating continues with the 10y above 5%, and the 25M Calpine shares unlock on 2027-06-30. The multiple falls to a VST-like 13-14x on 2028E of about $13.5: about $180.

base.story: 2026 lands at about $12 and the Feb 2027 guide comes in around $12.9, a small headline miss versus consensus. CEG then beats its midpoint again, as in 2022-2025. The market prices 2028E of about $14.6 at 18.5-19x, and buybacks ($2.8B authority) absorb much of the June unlock. The stock ends about $272.

bull.story: A GW-scale hyperscaler PPA for some of the 147M MWh of open nuclear lifts base EPS above the 20% CAGR. PJM rules favour existing nuclear, Crane restarts early, and forwards rise the enhanced earnings. 2028E reaches $16 or more at about 23x: about $375.

thesis_break_reason: $200 is about 13.7x my 2028E of $14.6 and about 15x 2027E. That is a VST-like multiple with no premium for contracted nuclear. It is also 12.5% below the 2026 low of $228.63, set in the Calpine-offering and Citi-downgrade washout. The June 2027 unlock and a 10y above 5% could push the stock to $210-220 without breaking the thesis (I agree with the supervisor). A trade at $200 would most likely mean the earnings path itself broke: a Feb 2027 guide far below consensus with a lower base-EPS path, failure to contract open nuclear MWh at a premium, adverse PJM/FERC colocation or cap rules, or a Crane slip.

reasoning: Round 2. I accept the supervisor's correction that management's 20%+ CAGR is for base EPS (2026 $6.70 to 2029 $11.65), not total EPS. I have rebuilt 2028E bottom-up from the Q2 deck's modeling tools: $9.45 base plus about $5.15 enhanced gives $14.6, down from $15.0. I only partly agree with the supervisor's $14.2. The Q2 deck raised 2027 enhanced gross margin to $2,825-3,025M (from $2,575-2,775M in March), which implies 2027 total of about $12.9 rather than $11.8-12.8. So consensus at $13.34 is only about 3% above the framework, not 5-10%. New base rate (requested by the supervisor): CEG has beaten its guidance midpoint every year from 2022 to 2025. Examples: the 2024 initial mid of $7.63 ended at $8.67, and the 2025 mid of $9.25 ended at $9.39. The one initial guide I could check against consensus (2026: $11-12 vs $11.72) came in about 2% below it and the stock fell 7% on the day. I therefore put a likely small headline miss in Feb 2027 (a negative catalyst of about 5%), followed by likely delivery at or above the midpoint. That is a dip-then-recover pattern and not a thesis break. Rates: I adopt the FRED 5.24% 10y and have added an FCF-yield leg at 6.5% ($255). I have dropped the 43% October-hike snapshot and the 35% Polymarket recession figure as forecast inputs, per the supervisor's source review. Supply: I confirm about 38M remaining consideration shares, 25M of them unlocking on 2027-06-30. My base-rate work from round 1 stands: extreme regime swings in CEG's own history ($85 to $366 over 2022-2025), 47% realized vol, and a 2026 drawdown shared with the IPP group (VST -8% and TLN -17% YTD) rather than a CEG-specific break. Fair value falls from $280 to $270, about 2% above spot, or about 3% with the roughly $1.9 dividend (not in the price ladder). The ladder is a lognormal with its median about $267, 42% sigma, and a 20% weight on a 50%-sigma component for fat tails. That moves P(>=265) from 0.53 to 0.515. The scenario mean is $274.75. Analyst targets (mean about $349) remain an upper-biased anchor, not the answer. Research this round: 5 searches plus 3 SEC primary documents.
